text:
Ana: Hey all — putting together the facilitation runbook for Strategy Week (June 12-14). Goal is to lock facilitators, hybrid tech owners, and prework distribution by EOD Friday. High level: 2-hour session blocks, clear launch criteria for decisions, and structured readouts.

Liam: I can facilitate Day 1 AM (customer insight deep-dive). Prefer 90m + 30m breakout.

Sasha: Can we require two facilitators per session (content + ops)? avoids single points and lets one handle chat/notes. Also need live captions for APAC attendees — @people-ops-bot any update on captioning?

people-ops-bot: Captioning vendor confirmed; live captions + transcript available. There is a $0 budget impact for up to 200 attendees. Submit requests by June 1.

Devin: I'll own hybrid tech checks and breakout room config. Plan: 30m tech test for hosts the day before. I'll produce a short checklist and a test calendar invite.

Riley: +1 to two facilitators. Suggest we run a 45m "mission alignment" lightning session with 3 breakout prompts and a shared Miro board. Gives clear artifacts for leads.

Ana: Nice — below is an initial runbook snippet. React with :white_check_mark: if you can own the line. I'll compile into the final Google Doc and share the public schedule.

```
Strategy Week facilitation runbook (draft)
- Session format: 2h blocks (90m working + 30m synth/readout)
- Facilitation: 2 facilitators (content, ops) — assign by June 2
- Tech owner: 1 host per virtual room + 1 floater (Devin volunteered)
- Accessibility: captions + transcript (submit by June 1)
- Prework: 1-pager + 3 prompts due 72h before session
- Decision criteria: each decision requires owner, timeline, and rollback plan
- Post-session artifact: Miro export + 3-line decision summary
- Dry run: 30m slot per session the day before
```

Liam: :white_check_mark: I'll take Day 1 AM content.

Sasha: :white_check_mark: I'll be ops for Day 2 and help with notes template. Can we add a timer guideline? 10/40/40 for breakout facilitation.

Devin: Adding tech checklist here: 
```
- Confirm presenter permissions in Zoom/Meet
- Test breakout creation and co-hosts
- Verify captions enabled and recording permissions
- Confirm Miro link access and templates
- Run mock join from VPN/blocked network
```

Riley: I can craft the lightning prompts and Miro templates — :white_check_mark:. Also propose a short icebreaker for Day 0 evening: 2 truths + 1 product lesson learned (10m).

Ana: Love it. Final asks before I publish: 1) Who can be backup facilitator for each session? 2) Any constraints for folks traveling (arrival windows)? 3) Accessibility or dietary constraints to flag for people-ops? Please drop answers here or DM me. I'll publish the runbook and schedule by Thu 5pm PT.

Sasha: I'll be backup for Day 1 PM and can collect dietary/accessibility notes.

Liam: Arriving on June 11 evening. No dietary restrictions.

Devin: I'll run the Day 11 dry-run at 4pm PT.

Ana: Thanks team — I'll post the Google Doc link when done. If you haven't reacted, please do so before EOD Friday. :rocket:
